subject: Renewal + private expansion: Sentinel Health - isolated analytics enclave
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Kyle Emerson <kyle.emerson@sentinelhealth.com>
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + private expansion: Sentinel Health - isolated analytics enclave

Hi Kyle —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. Per our notes, your current Dedicated contract is up for renewal on 2026-09-30. Sentinel mentioned interest in moving the analytics workload into a separate private/VPC enclave and adding capacity for batch inference and retention of audit logs for 24 months.

Quick proposal to get aligned:
- 24-month renewal (committed node pricing) with a 12% commitment discount vs month-to-month.
- Provision a new isolated analytics enclave in us-west-2: 3 x GPU inference nodes (N4 equivalent) plus a standby hot-swap node for failover.
- Network requirements and SOW attached (Annex A).
- We can target provision start the week of 2026-10-11 to meet your cutover testing window.

Next steps I suggest: procurement signoff on SOW + scope, ops handoff to schedule provisioning, final DocuSign for amendment. I've looped Dev for sizing and Markus for pricing confirmation.

Would you be available for a quick 30-min sync Thu or Fri this week?

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0192

Attachments: SOW_Sentinel_2026.pdf, AnnexA_Network_Requirements.xlsx

Subject: Re: Renewal + private expansion: Sentinel Health - isolated analytics enclave

Thanks Grace — this looks promising. A few clarifying points from our side: 
1) Do you have an estimate for per-token cost impact if we route analytics traffic into the isolated enclave vs current pooled environment?
2) We need SOC 2 evidence and encryption-at-rest details documented in the SOW.
3) Procurement wants a sample amendment that shows the 24-month pricing and early-termination terms before they greenlight the budget.

Procurement (cc'd) will confirm availability for a meeting. Friday morning PT works for me.

—Kyle

Ben / Kyle —

Attached: Draft SOW (SOW_Sentinel_2026.pdf) and Annex A (network requirements). I've also uploaded a DocuSign placeholder (link below) that we can convert into an amendment once node counts and final pricing are confirmed.

Producer-level answers now:
- Token/unit economics: expected per-token unit cost in isolated enclave is roughly +6% relative to your current pooled footprint due to dedicated shard overhead; with the committed 24-month discount the effective per-token cost is ~8% lower than month-to-month in your current Dedicated plan. I'll include a short cost table in the amendment.
- SOC 2: attaching the SOC 2 Type II summary (redacted); full report can be provided under NDA.
- KMS: we support customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS/HSM). Details are in Annex A.

Handoff notes for Ops (Dev / Markus): once we confirm the 3+1 node topology I'll need an ETA for provisioning and a runbook for cutover testing.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/placeholder/sentinel-58294
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/58294

Grace

Hi all —

Sizing / ops notes from infra:
- Recommended build: 3 x g4-inference nodes (N4-equivalent) for steady-state, plus 1 hot-standby node. This supports your projected 150 concurrent streams for analytics and a 3x burst cushion for batch jobs.
- Storage: 12 TB block volume with daily KV cache persistence (retention policy configurable).
- Network: Annex A covers ports; we additionally require an IP allowlist for our provisioning host (listed in the attached spreadsheet).
- Provisioning ETA: 3–4 weeks from signed amendment + completion of onboarding checklist (we can prioritize accelerate to 2 weeks with a 10% expedite fee).

Pricing quick reference (pre-commit discount):
- 3+1 topology: $XX,XXX/month (baseline). 24-month commit reduces effective monthly by 12% as Grace noted.

I'll prepare a short runbook for the cutover plan and share before the Friday call.

—Dev
Dev Patel
Technical Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

Thanks for the materials and the runbook preview. Procurement has initial approval pending a couple of small redlines:
- Add a 30-day SLA credit window for provisioning delays beyond the 3–4 week timeline.
- Clarify data retention truncation terms for audit logs (we want 24 months searchable).

If you can update the amendment with those two points, we will execute via DocuSign by 2026-08-20 and target provisioning the week of 2026-10-11 as requested.
